receipts.scope: Actual finite normalized braid networks with arbitrary real coefficients, linear heads and braid output skips. Exact same-input-arity equivalence between matching-number-at-most-r and cover-number-at-most-r representability; exact H(N,r+1) equivalence to cover-r MAX exclusion. All-input cycle/forest replacement preserves signed aggregate cancellation and normalization.
Research-only exact actual H(5,2), using the closed all-real star certificate and generic cycle deletion; no triangle import or theorem dependency.

For every N>=3, every actual nine-array affine-skip two-hidden-layer real ReLU network computing MAX_N on all real inputs with total h1<=N^2 satisfies h2>=N^2/650000. Arbitrary biases and all skips are permitted. No unproved structural or probability premise.

Every exact translation-normalized MAX_N network admits a same-index normalized MAX_n restriction for 2n<=N with 16 times its fourth falling support moment <=105h1 and 8 times its non-braid first-row count <=h1, simultaneously on one actual model.

Arbitrary real nine-array affine-skip MAX_N. If C hits each zero-bias, zero-sum first row with at least three nonzero coefficients, and m=N-|C|>=3, then original h2>=m^2/3000000. No first-width bound. The separate 4^q result explicitly assumes H(4q+1,q).
Exact nine-array coordinate quotient; MAX transport; same-size deletion dominance; transported quadratic and conditional bounds.
For every N>=3, any real affine-skip network computing actual MAX_N on all real inputs satisfies h2>=min(N^2,N^4/h1)/650000, without a first-width cap; h1 counts original total first slots.

Original nine-array affine-skip networks computing actual MAX_N at every real input. Arbitrary real covectors, weights, biases, and skips. The conclusion counts original h2; total first width need not be bounded.

For every N>=3, every actual nine-array affine-skip two-hidden-layer real ReLU network computing MAX_N on all real inputs with total h1<=N^2 satisfies h2>=N^2/175000. Arbitrary biases and all skips are permitted. No unproved structural or probability premise.
For every N>=3, any real affine-skip network computing actual MAX_N on all real inputs satisfies h2>=min(N^2,N^4/h1)/175000, without a first-width cap; h1 counts original total first slots.

For every N>=3, any real affine-skip network computing actual MAX_N on all real inputs satisfies h2>=min(N^2,N^4/h1prime)/175000, where h1prime counts original W columns with at least one nonzero entry. Output-only first neurons are unrestricted.

Original h1*h2>=N^4/700000 with no upper-width hypothesis: ordinary real biased networks for N>=6, arbitrary real affine-skip biased networks for N>=15, both computing actual MAX_N on all real inputs.

Actual real nine-array affine-skip/bias MAX_N networks with every first covector zero-sum and support at most two, and every original summed signed interaction graph of maximum degree at most two. No first-hidden-width cap, sign condition, fixed graph ordering, genericity hypothesis, or matching conjecture is assumed. Sharp bound for every m>=3: 2*choose(N,m)<=h2*(2N+(m-1)N^2). For N>=6: h2>=4*2^N/[N^3(N+1)]. The earlier fourfold weaker bounds remain verified compatibility statements. A separate normalized theorem requires braid support only for feeding first rows, while retaining translation normalization for all rows.
